name: Tapestry
overview: The Scriptures reveal the intricate craftsmanship involved in the construction of the tabernacle, emphasizing the careful weaving and coupling of ten curtains made of fine twined linen in blue, purple, and scarlet, adorned with cherubim designs executed by skilled embroiderers. The detailed instructions for making loops and gold taches to join the curtains into one unified tabernacle highlight the intentionality and beauty God designed for His dwelling place among His people.
